beats.text: Happy couples don't just talk more. They answer tiny moments!
Like this one: hey, look at this bird!
Psychologist John Gottman followed newlyweds for six years. He watched how they answered these little bids for attention.
Couples who were still married turned toward each other eighty-six percent of the time. And the divorced couples?
So when they say: look! Look!

sources: Gottman (with Driver) – newlywed study, six-year follow-up: couples still married had turned toward partners' bids 86% of the time, divorced couples 33% (Gottman Institute, 'Turn Toward Instead of Away'; Gottman & DeClaire, The Relationship Cure, 2001).
